# First Sight engine (vendored)

Copied unchanged from Band Arcade (github.com/stemband/band-arcade), commit 2f382e1 2026-11-08, on 2026-11-10.
Do not edit these files here. Fix them in Band Arcade, then run `python3 tools/sync_first_sight.py <band-arcade>`.

| File | From |
|---|---|
| instruments.js | shared/instruments.js |
| scales.js | shared/scales.js |
| counting.js | shared/counting.js |
| ui.js | shared/ui.js |
| notation.js | shared/notation.js |
| etudes.js | first-sight/etudes.js |
| winds.js | shared/winds.js |
| backing.js | music-highway/backing.js |
| music.woff2 | shared/fonts/music.woff2 |
